annotation.title_clean: Instrucción 15/V-113: Autorización de pruebas o ensayos de investigación realizados con vehículos de conducción automatizada en vías abiertas al tráfico en general
annotation.title_en: Instruction 15/V-113: Authorisation of research tests or trials with automated driving vehicles on roads open to general traffic
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Dirección General de Tráfico (DGT), Subdirección General de Gestión de la Movilidad
annotation.summary_en: Spanish DGT instruction (Nov 2015) setting the procedure for special authorisations to test automated vehicles (levels 3–5) on open roads. It requires insurance, accredited technical-service certification, designated drivers able to take control, risk assessment (HARA/FMEA), override and emergency-stop tests, cybersecurity, and braking, AEB and lane-control tests.
key_provisions_or_claims: Special DGT authorisation required for testing level 3-5 autonomous vehicles on open roads, valid up to 2 years, renewable.
Mandatory insurance covering at least compulsory motor limits plus civil liability for test damages.
Vehicle certification by ENAC-accredited technical service: documentation, inspection, dynamic checks, or equivalent EU authorisation.
Driver remains responsible and must be able to take full control at any time; override and emergency stop must have priority.
Risk assessment (HARA/FMEA per ISO 26262), software version control and cybersecurity required.
